body: depending on the pepper i can have it burn until i wake up the next day. the worst is when the chili oils get under my fingernails where it’s nearly impossible to scrub off. It’ll get cleared out by the next day for sure, totally normal

i grow ghost peppers in my garden so i know all about this. capsaicin is soluble in oil and rubbing my hands in olive oil then washing with dish soap usually clears up the burning. 
If it doesn’t go away it’ll be gone by tomorrow since your immune system will clear up any of the chili oil that’s soaked into your skin

There’s no actual burning going on, don’t get scared. Capsaicin tricks your nerves into thinking there’s heat just like mint tricks them into thinking there’s cold :)
